name: litescrape-mcp-server
description: Google, Bing, DuckDuckGo and Google Maps search results, free without an API key.
long_description: Live search results straight from Google Search, Bing, DuckDuckGo and Google Maps as structured JSON, through the Litescrape API. Works with no API key and no account from a free daily allowance per network (25 Google Search calls, 50 each for Bing, DuckDuckGo and Google Maps). Add a Litescrape API key for Google AI Mode, Google AI Overview and Google Shopping, and to lift every limit. Every tool returns the API's JSON unchanged after a one-line summary; result_groups keeps only the groups you need.
